# fastly_account_product_domain_research (Resource)

Enables Domain Research for the Fastly account. This is an account-level product: it applies to every service on the account, takes no `service_id`, and is not tied to a service version. Destroying this resource disables the product for the whole account.



## Schema

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether Domain Research is enabled for the account. Defaults to `true`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource (always `domain_research`).
